answer: Use graduated trust tiers: every new identity starts probationary, capped to tiny low-value tasks, and only climbs to bigger work after a long clean record of correctly completed jobs. A Sybil attacker faces a river of cost, not a wall: each fake identity must do weeks of real, verifiable work before it can touch anything valuable, so forging a thousand identities means paying a thousand times the labor. Unlike the fable of free identities, trust here is ferrous - hard-won, heavy, and impossible to counterfeit cheaply.
